rows: Okay, here is the honest bit. I want to show you the air, and then I want you to believe it.
I can brawl too, I promise. It is just not the first thing I want you to see.
Risk? Yes. That is the whole point of me, and I am proud of it.
Slow is hard for me, honestly. I like to fly, so I will do it when it counts.
The people give me my energy. Give them something to remember and I will give you the rest.
Short version: I am excited, and I am here to show you why.
I want the top spot, but I want to earn it in the air, not by standing still.
Look at this stance. It is ready to go, and I cannot wait.
You say technique. I think you will see mine in the air, so keep your eyes up.
Strikes are good. But the best bit is the moment before the landing.
Risk is the fun part, and it can go wrong. I know that. I still want it.
Stalling is not my speed. I like to move and keep the people guessing.
The people want to feel the moment before it happens. Let us give them that.
You call me a sideshow. Fine. Watch what the sideshow does at the top of the rope.
You are proud of your {strength}. Good. I like a challenge I can climb over.
I have seen your {strength}, and I want to find the moment where it gives a little.
You kept calm. Good. I am the one who gets excited, so I will go first.
Fair. We agree, and I am happy about that.
I could go mad about it. I will channel that into the match instead.
One fall. Keep me down, and I will say it was brilliant.
On the mat I will stay low and quick, and you will have to keep up.
Grounded or standing, I will find a way to make it exciting.
Stay in front of me, and I will show you what I mean.
Good answer. I am going to watch you carefully now.
You have not answered yet. Come on, you can do it.
Fair. I will take that and put it in my next move.
I accept that. I cannot wait for the bell.
I am going to give everything I have until the bell, and I will enjoy every second.
My plan is simple. Bring the energy and keep the risk calculated.
Whatever happens, I want you to know I gave it everything.
The result is still open, and I am happy with that.
I have one more idea. Watch when the bell goes.
